programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 60 [P13]
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family’s debts. programme.title: CINTA DARI SURGA EPS 21 [P13]
programme.desc: It tells the story of Cinta (Melayu Nicole Hall), who is caught in a complicated love triangle with Revan and Bayu, filled with action and comedy. Cinta is forced to marry Viko to save her adoptive mother, leading to a deeply difficult and emotional dilemma.

programme.title: ADA DUA CINTA EPS 27 [P13]
programme.desc: It tells the story of two girls, Mecca (who comes from humble circumstances) and Medina (who is wealthy), who are connected through Ayu—Mecca’s biological mother—who adopted Medina. Conflict arises when they both fall in love with the same man, creating an emotional romantic drama that tugs at the heartstrings.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 99-100 [P13]
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husband—Lala enters the third season of the Champion of Chef cooking competition, and her victory brings her closer to Julian, one of the judges in the competition.

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 10 [P13]
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 87 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. The situation reaches its peak when Arya refuses to provide for Meira anymore. He even refuses to help cover the medical expenses of Meira’s mother, Siti. Arya also stops paying for Lani’s college tuition, Meira’s younger sister. Even though, before they got married, it was Arya who promised Meira that he would cover all of her living expenses as well as her family’s, so that she could focus on being a housewife.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: The King is having a blast with his favorite Jelvis toy when Rita asks to play with it. King, who fancies himself a good sharer, let’s her. Rita takes advantage of the King and soon tricks him out of ALL his toys! Though Rita feels triumphant at first, her happiness is short lived. Rita must discover the best thing about toys; when you share them with others you have a lot more fun.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Rita finally gets close enough to a dodo to pet it---but only because it injured its foot. She takes the critter home, nursing it with affection and too much food. The now overweight dodo needs exercise badly. Rita learns that caring for others requires what is good for them, not for you.And, in doing so, now has a new best friend

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: On a seemingly normal day, Goomo steps outside for a nice jog when he notices that something is slightly different about Jammbo today…everything has stopped moving! The music has stopped. The dodos are frozen mid-air. Even his friends are stiff as statues! It’s up to Goomo and his helpful headphones to find out what happened and get Jammbo flowing again.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: While exploring the musical nature of spring on Jammbo, Goomo realizes he has a fear of Burst into Song flowers. In search of a cure, Mina conducts a series of tests to help Goomo deal with his over the top reactions to the singing plants. In the end, Goomo realize that when you understand your fears, there is nothing scary at all.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and it's up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of America's largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]
programme.desc: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africa's South Coast.

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]
programme.desc: View South Africa's mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africa's journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

programme.title: Wild Heroes [P13]
programme.desc: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

programme.title: Wildest Survival S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earth's species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

programme.title: Wild Heroes [P13]
programme.desc: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible interactions with predatory killer whales. The humpbacks also face a world full of human threats, from large container ships, to the impact of seismic testing in the search for oil and gas, now threatening their very survival once more.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOceans' scientists on an expedition to uncover more of their secrets and behaviours.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: In A 'Tale Of Two Sharks' we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

programme.title: Evolving Vegan S2 [P13]
programme.desc: In the Big Easy, Mena explores a charming host of plant-based Louisiana staples—vegan beignets, gumbo, biscuits and po boys—with food historian Zella Palmer and cookbook author Timothy Pakron. As an aperitif, he sips his way through a lesson in cocktails created in the heart of the grand city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Evolving Vegan S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Mena feasts with magician and Vegas legend Penn Jillette. He explores the off-strip Sin City vegan food scene, indulging in plant-based “Beef” Wellington, sky-high waffles, and intricate dim sum, then dines with cookbook author Carleigh Bodrug.

programme.title: Evolving Vegan S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Bathed in sunshine and Big Latin Culture, Mena learns to make classic Cubanos and traditional Puerto Rican mofongo—vegan-style. He cruises the seas with cookbook author Radhi Devlukia, takes actor Matt Murray to South Beach for mouth-watering molten lava cake, and harvests and tastes astonishing exotic fruits.

programme.title: The Barbie Story [P13]
programme.desc: Barbie celebrates her 65th birthday in 2024. But she is way more than just a 12-inches long piece of plastic and way more than a toy. The legendary blond bombshell has grown into a phenomenon and a children’s sensation.

programme.title: Janet Jackson: The Art Of Seduction [P13]
programme.desc: Noted for her fierce independence, her magnetic aura and her ever so charming voice, Janet Jackson became a catalyst for her growth on MTV; embracing her identity, and reaching up to the heights of stardom.

programme.title: Beyonce: Queen & Country [P13]
programme.desc: Follow the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles-Carter, from her early days as the lead singer of Destiny's Child to her solo career. Discover how the superstar's music style and inspirations have developed over the years.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Great White Shark [P13]
programme.desc: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: The end of winter heralds one of the world's greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of America's largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

programme.title: Battle Of Okinawa In Color [P13]
programme.desc: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze attacks at sea.

programme.title: Battle Of Midway: The True Story [P13]
programme.desc: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]
programme.desc: View South Africa's mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africa's journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]
programme.desc: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the world's largest inland oasis.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

programme.title: Evolving Vegan S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Bathed in sunshine and Big Latin Culture, Mena learns to make classic Cubanos and traditional Puerto Rican mofongo—vegan-style. He cruises the seas with cookbook author Radhi Devlukia, takes actor Matt Murray to South Beach for mouth-watering molten lava cake, and harvests and tastes astonishing exotic fruits.

programme.title: Evolving Vegan S2 [P13]
programme.desc: In the heart of Japan, Mena devours plant-based sushi and ramen. He learns to cook soba noodles from scratch, home-made mochi, and takes part in a traditional tea ceremony.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 [P13]
programme.desc: Ben’s food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S3 [P13]
programme.desc: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

Self-funded and with minimal experience, she quickly jumps to Formula 4, becoming the first female driver in the Chinese Championship. She faces the huge challenge of driving skill and finding crucial funding.

programme.title: Zero To Macao [P13]
programme.desc: Vivian's journey hits a roadblock when the Macau Grand Prix is removed from the calendar, threatening to end her dream. Even with a small chance of hope, she faces the immense task of securing a car, a team, and a co-driver in mere weeks.

programme.title: BLOSSOM
programme.desc: Song Mo yang giat menyiasat kes pembunuhan bapa saudaranya Jiang Mei Sun, membawa Dou Zhao ke sebuah kapal lanun yang dirampas oleh pihak berkuasa. Mereka diserang hendap oleh anggota tentera dan terpaksa terjun ke dalam laut.

programme.title: GO - GO - GO! ( SS 4 )
programme.desc: Episod ini menampilkan hos bersama empat pengacara TV jemputan yang dibahagikan kepada dua kumpulan. Diketuai oleh Rickman dan Yun Mei Xin, mereka akan bersaing dalam pelbagai siri permainan mencabar di Putrajaya Challenge Park.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Ruzhen gembira akhirnya Chee Qian pulang ke rumah dan dapat makan malam bersama ahli keluarga termasuk Jia Mei. Ruguan dan Chiu Yeh ingin Huan Run kembali tinggal bersama mereka tetapi ditolak.

programme.title: NO RETURN
programme.desc: Kwai-sim diminta tambah nilai derma kepada Jeneral Loong. Abang Kwai-sim enggan bekerjasama, Wai Ho ugutnya untuk dapatkan wang. Hantaran dirompak. Loong beri Kwai-sim 2 minggu penuhi wang tebusan dan sembuhkan penyakitnya oleh Shap-chat.

programme.title: STAND OR FALL
programme.desc: Ibu mertua Jing Zhiqiu mendesaknya untuk melahirkan anak kedua. Lin Hao dan Xuanxuan mendaftar diri sebagai suami isteri. Lin Hao tidak berpuas hati apabila diberitahu Xuanxuan sudah membayar deposit sewa untuk membuka kafe.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Ling Feng menyerang Daisy apabila mengetahui hubungan Daisy dengan Zi Sheng. Ling Feng menuduh Daisy menggoda Zi Sheng kerana Zi Sheng adalah anak kepada bos kaya Kumpulan Jing Ying. Ling Feng ingin menampar Daisy.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Ivan tersedar selepas pembedahan dan terharu dengan jagaan baik Zai Xing serta Fu Mi. Sementara itu, Yun Jin memperoleh keputusan ujian DNA yang membuktikan tiada pertalian antara Zai Xing dan Ivan, lalu menunjukkannya kepada An Jie.

programme.title: CALL OF DESTINY
programme.desc: Rijin mendapat tahu daripada Feng Jie bahawa Yu Ling dan Dingqin mengenali satu sama lain serta pernah bergaduh sebelum kematian Yu Ling. Sementara itu, Dingqin dituduh menyerang, dan You Shan cuba memujuk Yao Xing melepaskannya.

programme.title: MY SWEET MOBSTER
programme.desc: Kumpulan Ji Hwan dan Eun Ha berseronok di resort, dengan Ji Hwan memasak. Selepas meluahkan cinta pada Eun Ha, perangai Ji Hwan berubah. Dia juga mengesyaki mereka diintip oleh orang asing dan meminta II Young untuk periksa CCTV.

programme.title: MISSION HOMECOMING
programme.desc: The three brothers risked their lives to rescue Xingfu and Ruyi. During the rescuing, Jixiang was willing to sacrifice himself and become a hostage to save Ruyi and Xingfu, but Ruyi was unwilling and told Jixiang to ignore her.

programme.title: BLOSSOM
programme.desc: Dou Zhao menyamar sebagai tabib diraja untuk bertemu De Zhen untuk memberi kata-kata semangat. Sementara itu, Song Mo giat menyiasat dalang di sebalik pembunuhan bapa saudaranya, Jiang Mei Sun. An Su didakwa bersekongkol dengan lanun.

programme.title: BLOSSOM
programme.desc: Dou Zhao menyedari bahawa Song Mo akan berada dalam bahaya kerana bertelagah dengan ayahnya. Tidak lama kemudian, Song Mo menerima surat dari keluarganya memanggilnya pulang dengan segera kerana ibunya sakit tenat.

programme.title: GO - GO - GO! ( SS 4 )
programme.desc: Episod ini hos bersama empat orang tetamu jemputan yang merupakan hos TV dibahagikan kepada dua kumpulan yang masing-masing diketuai oleh Rickman dan Yun Mei Xin untuk mengambil bahagian dalam siri permainan di Sunway Pyramid Ice.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Nenek Xiao Yi terserempak dengan Huan Qi sedang bersama Shu Shu di sebuah taman. Dia mula bergaduh dengan Shu Shu yang juga memandang rendah pada Xiao Yi. Nenek Xiao Yi membawa cucunya untuk melawat Ruguan dan Chiu Yeh.

programme.title: NO RETURN
programme.desc: Wai Ho dan Ni Li lambat hantar wang/emas, menyebabkan Jeneral Loong menembak orang awam. Kwai-sim dan Loong Shi-hai bekerjasama membunuh Loong. Shi-hai dan ibunya ikut Kwai-sim ke Shanghai. Shap-chat meragui identiti Shi-hai.

programme.title: STAND OR FALL
programme.desc: Ding Ning menolak permintaan Guan Wen untuk bekerja sebagai pengarah pembangunan perniagaan di Wanli. Guan Wen mengugut Ding Ning bahawa dia akan bercakap dengan CEO Chen memaksa Ding Ning menerimanya.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Qing Tian hampir lemas di kolam sekolah akibat diperdaya Meng Zi, namun diselamatkan Zhi Han dan Yi Lin. Meng Zi berpura-pura meminta maaf, manakala Yun Jin dan An Jie pula berdepan bahaya apabila diculik oleh Chang Sheng.

programme.title: CALL OF DESTINY
programme.desc: Dingqin menyerang Youshan demi membalas dendam terhadap Shujuan, lalu memutuskan hubungan dengan Rijin yang menyiasatnya. Sementara itu, Mily mencari suaminya yang hilang sebelum sebuah mayat tanpa kepala ditemui oleh pihak polis.

programme.title: CAHAYA KAMPUNG BARU (CAPSULE)
programme.desc: Episod ini pengacara mengunjungi Kampung Baru Tanjung Sepat di Selangor, untuk melawat sebuah ladang koko tempatan. Pemilik Lees Cocoa, Adam dan Terence Lee menyambut kedatangan pengacara dengan mesra.

programme.title: MY SWEET MOBSTER
programme.desc: Eun Ha membeli kostum dan alat solek di sebuah pasaraya. Ji Hwan mucul dengan tiba-tiba untuk memberi bantuan kepada Eun Ha. Tiba-tiba terjadi gangguan elektrik. Ji Hwan bertindak untuk menghiburkan kanak-kanak yang dalam ketakutan.

programme.title: LOGIN TO MY LIFE
programme.desc: Seorang gadis, Xiao Juan bercita-cita menjadi seorang penyanyi. Dia yang bekerja di sebuah kedai pendandan rambut sering mengambil cuti untuk menyertai ujibakat yang dianjurkan oleh pelbagai pihak tetapi tidak berjaya.

programme.title: BLOSSOM
programme.desc: Dou Zhao cuba membangkitkan semangat Song Mo, yang kecewa kerana kekurangan petunjuk berkaitan kes pembunuhan Jiang Mei Sun. Dalam pada itu, Song Mo secara diam-diam menyusun semula pasukan tentera yang setia kepada Jiang Mei Sun

programme.title: BLOSSOM

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Jennifer moves into a new apartment after leaving her abusive husband. As she starts life anew, something keeps biting her when she sleeps, leading her to be sleep deprived, paranoid and paralyzed with fear of the unseen.

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents' dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: Jas's peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sister's murderer.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: 3AM - The Campus
programme.desc: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: A year after Jamie's wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

programme.title: Red Snow
programme.desc: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Luke's vampire companions track him down...

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.desc: Kiara adalah seorang gadis remaja yang memiliki kemampuan 'Supernatural' di mana dia mampu melihat dan berkomunikasi dengan makhluk halus. Kehidupan biasanya berubah menjadi penuh cabaran apabila dia cuba membantu roh-roh yang mempunyai urusan tidak selesai di dunia. Di tengah konflik misteri tersebut, Kiara juga harus mengemudi kisah cinta dan persahabatan di sekolahnya yang semakin rumit. Lakonan : Nicole Parham, Bastian Steel, Endy Arfian dan ramai lagi.

programme.desc: Drama mengisahkan seorang gadis dari Itali yang berbapakan seorang lelaki Malaysia kembali ke Malaysia untuk mencari bapanya. Sewaktu pencariannya, dia terbabit dalam menyelesaikan masalah pembuangan bahan toksik ke sungai di Terengganu dan Pahang. Dalam masa yang sama dia juga turut terjebak dalam percintaan. Lakonan : Nadia Brian, Shafie Naswip, Mahmud Ali Basha dan Fuad Geoff.

Mereka membentuk sebuah kumpulan muzik (band) yang dinamakan One Music. Walau bagaimanapun, jalan menuju impian ini tidak semudah yang disangka. Konflik berlaku antara kedua-dua menantu iaitu, Mohana dan Ramya. Mohana, tidak suka tinggal bersama keluarga besar mertuanya dan kerap memujuk suaminya untuk tinggal berasingan. Lakonan : K.Gunasegaran , Malarvili dan Ben G.

programme.title: Perfume
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang suri rumah pertengahan umur, Min Jae-hee yang hidupnya musnah akibat kecurangan suami dan tekanan hidup yang menghancurkan keyakinan dirinya. Di saat dia hampir berputus asa, dia menerima sebotol minyak wangi misteri yang mengubah penampilannya menjadi wanita muda dan cantik bernama Min Ye-rin. Dengan identiti baharu ini, dia mula mengejar impiannya untuk menjadi seorang model dan secara tidak sengaja terlibat dengan Seo Yi-do, seorang pereka fesyen yang berbakat tetapi eksentrik serta menghidap pelbagai fobia dan alahan pelik. Hubungan mereka berkembang dalam dunia fesyen yang penuh cabaran, di samping isu identiti, cinta sejati dan peluang kedua dalam kehidupan. Lakonan : Shin Sung-rok, Ha Jae-sook, Go Won-hee, Cha Ye-ryun, Kim Min-kyu dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Hening Rindu
programme.desc: Kisah Mariam, yang bersuamikan seorang penagih dadah, Hakim. Penderitaan dan pengorbanan Mariam dalam meneruskan kehidupan bersama anak-anaknya teruji dengan berat apabila dia ditangkap dan dipenjarakan atas kesalahan yang tidak dia lakukan. Bertambah deritanya apabila ibu tirinya bersekongkol dengan Hakim untuk menjual anaknya yang masih bayi kepada satu pasangan. Kemuncaknya selepas ibu tirinya meninggal dunia dia baru mengetahui bahawa arwah ibu tirinya telah menjual tanah dan rumah pusaka peninggalan ayahnya. Lakonan : Nazeera Sardi, Fauzi Nawawi, Redza Hasbi, Faye Kusairi dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Law & Order : Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: SVU dipanggil apabila seorang wanita muda ditemui dalam keadaan dirogol dan dibius sehingga mengalami gangguan psikotik. Untuk memerangkapnya ketika beraksi, Rollins menyamar sebagai seorang pelajar yang bercita-cita tinggi dan menemui beberapa perkara yang mengejutkan. Lakonan : Mariska Hargitay, Kelli Giddish, Ice-T, Peter Scanavino dan ramai lagi.

programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: ASEAN - Kembara Alam Borneo
programme.desc: Kembara Alam Borneo is a programme under the ASEAN segment hosted by Razzuan Rosli, exploring the unique heritage and natural beauty of Borneo. The programme highlights the island’s rich cultural diversity, local traditions, and the customs of its various ethnic communities, offering viewers a closer look at the vibrant identity and way of life found across Borneo.\n

programme.title: ASEAN - Gastronomic Trail Of Asia
programme.desc: Gastronomic Trail of Asia is a programme under the ASEAN segment that takes viewers on a culinary journey across the region, exploring the flavours and recipes of diverse Asian cuisines. The programme also highlights the rich cultural heritage, ethnic traditions, and unique destinations behind each dish, offering a deeper appreciation of Asia’s vibrant food culture and communities.

programme.title: ASEAN - Bisikan Dari Kota Pusaka
programme.desc: Bisikan Dari Kota Pusaka is a programme under the ASEAN segment that explores historic administrative towns and heritage cities across the country. The programme highlights the unique history, cultural significance, architecture, and local identity of these heritage locations, offering viewers a deeper appreciation of the nation’s rich historical legacy and development.\n

programme.title: ASEAN - Simfoni Alam
programme.desc: Simfoni Alam is a documentary programme under the ASEAN segment that explores the beauty of wildlife and the natural environment while highlighting important environmental and conservation issues. The programme offers viewers greater awareness and appreciation of biodiversity, ecosystems, and the challenges faced in preserving nature and wildlife habitats.

programme.title: ASEAN - Warna-Warni Asia
programme.desc: Warna-Warni Asia is a travelogue programme under the ASEAN segment that takes viewers on a vibrant journey to explore fascinating destinations across Asia. The programme showcases the region’s colourful cultures, unique attractions, local lifestyles, and scenic landscapes, offering audiences an engaging glimpse into the diversity and beauty of Asia.

programme.title: ASEAN - Dari Borneo Ke Pantai Timur
programme.desc: Dari Borneo Ke Pantai Timur is a travel documentary under the ASEAN segment that follows the journey of a young man from Borneo as he visits and explores the East Coast for the very first time. The programme highlights his experiences discovering local culture, traditions, lifestyles, and the unique charm of the region through a fresh and personal perspective.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - Iqra'
programme.desc: Iqra’ is a programme under the Muslim World segment that focuses on Quranic learning through talaqqi and guided recitation sessions. The programme provides lessons and guidance on proper Quran reading techniques and tajwid for viewers of all age groups, promoting a deeper understanding and appreciation of Quranic recitation.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - Kota Warisan Alam
programme.desc: Kota Warisan Alam is a travelogue programme under the Dunia Melayu segment that explores heritage towns and historical cities across the country. The programme highlights interesting attractions, cultural landmarks, and unique local experiences, offering viewers insights into destinations that reflect the nation’s rich heritage and natural beauty.\n

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - Tamadun Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Tamadun Yang Hilang is a historical documentary under the Dunia Melayu segment that explores the rise, glory, and eventual fall of the Al-Andalus civilisation. The programme highlights the rich legacy of Islamic culture, knowledge, architecture, and governance in medieval Spain, while reflecting on the historical factors behind the decline of one of the world’s most influential civilisations.

programme.title: Pewaris Legasi
programme.desc: Pewaris Legasi memaparkan proses penyambungan ilmu kraf daripada seorang guru kepada murid yang akan meneruskan legasi yang kian luput ditelan zaman.

programme.title: Khazanah Borneo
programme.desc: Majalah pengkajian peninggalan sejarah di Sabah dan Sarawak yang menghasilkan banyak kesan-kesan sejarah.

programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: Global - Behind The Mic
programme.desc: Behind The Mic brings radio-style conversations to television, featuring light and engaging discussions on everyday topics suitable for all audiences. Discussion Title : The importance of confinement and emotional affairs

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us under the GLOBAL segment features a collection of inspiring and unique stories from around the world, including animal rescue efforts in post-disaster Japan, the enduring presence of Larry the Cat at 10 Downing Street, innovations unveiled at the Mobile World Congress 2026, celebrations marking the 100th anniversary of Winnie the Pooh, and the cultural beauty of Japan’s plum blossom season that symbolises the arrival of spring.

programme.title: ASEAN Friendship Concert 2025
programme.desc: Celebrate friendship and cultural harmony at the ASEAN Friendship Concert 2025, a spectacular showcase featuring talented artists from across Southeast Asia. Enjoy captivating performances by ASEAN's finest - from Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, and beyond!

programme.title: ASEAN - BIZ : ASEAN REGIONAL TOURISM
programme.desc: This ASEAN BIZ series explores the growth and potential of regional tourism across Southeast Asia, highlighting collaborative efforts between ASEAN member states to promote sustainable tourism, cultural exchange and economic opportunities.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (HAFAZAN)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran memorisation recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme highlights participants from Angola, France, Central African Republic, and Cameroon as they demonstrate their mastery and memorisation of the Holy Quran through specially tested recitation sessions.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - PUISI NUSANTARA
programme.desc: Puisi Nusantara is a magazine-style programme celebrating the richness of Malay literature and culture, featuring cultural figures and traditional music performances

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - LEGASI MARITIM MELAYU
programme.desc: Legasi Maritim Melayu is a documentary segment under Dunia Melayu that explores the rich maritime heritage of the Malay civilisation. The programme highlights the ingenuity and achievements of the Malay people in navigation, shipbuilding, seafaring knowledge, and maritime trade, showcasing their historical role as skilled sailors and influential players in regional and international maritime networks.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - GHAZAL TERMASYHUR
programme.desc: Ghazal Termasyhur is a special programme under Dunia Melayu organised by Johor FM, featuring a compilation of traditional Ghazal performances by renowned local artists and cultural performers from across the country. The programme celebrates the beauty and uniqueness of Malay musical heritage while preserving and promoting the timeless art of Ghazal to wider audiences.

programme.title: LIVE - WORLD TODAY
programme.desc: A comprehensive news bulletin beginning with the latest developments from Malaysia, followed by key stories from around the globe. The program concludes with a concise roundup of international sports highlights.

programme.title: Special Interview with RTM DG : Ashwad Ismail
programme.desc: An exclusive conversation on RTM World’s current direction and future plans, as the Director-General shares insights on growth, innovation, and the broadcaster’s evolving role in a dynamic media landscape.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE - STRAIT OF HORMUZ
programme.desc: Perspective – Strait of Hormuz is a programme under the GLOBAL segment that examines current international developments following the conflict in West Asia, particularly tensions surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, a key global trade and energy route. Hosted by Suhil, the discussion features Prof. Dr. Tan Peck Leong, who provides insights into the geopolitical and economic impact of the crisis on global markets, energy supplies, and international stability.

programme.title: Global - Behind The Mic
programme.desc: Behind The Mic brings radio-style conversations to television, featuring light and engaging discussions on everyday topics suitable for all audiences. Discussion Title : Mind Your Business

programme.title: Global - Fresh Brew
programme.desc: Fresh Brew is a casual talk show under the GLOBAL segment that explores contemporary social and lifestyle issues through engaging and insightful discussions. In this episode, the programme focuses on New Parents Mental Health, highlighting the emotional, psychological, and social challenges faced by new mothers and fathers while raising awareness on the importance of mental well-being and support systems for parents.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us under the GLOBAL segment highlights unique stories and cultural experiences from around the world, featuring topics such as the preservation of traditional Japanese Geisha culture, the beauty of apricot blossom season in Pakistan, endangered falcon conservation efforts in Kazakhstan, international performances by The Royal Ballet, and wildlife conservation initiatives involving the endangered Malayan tapir. The programme also showcases the cultural richness and natural beauty of Malaysia.

programme.title: ASEAN_MUSICAL ON 46th ASEAN SUMMIT GALA DINNER
programme.desc: Musical on 46th ASEAN Summit Gala Dinner – Part 2 is the second and final instalment featuring performances from the Gala Dinner held in conjunction with the 46th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur in May 2025. The programme showcases a vibrant selection of musical and cultural performances presented during the prestigious gathering, celebrating regional unity, diversity, and the spirit of ASEAN through arts and entertainment.

programme.title: ASEAN - BIZ : ASEAN GREEN FUTURE
programme.desc: ASEAN BIZ – ASEAN Green Future explores regional efforts and initiatives towards sustainable development and green economic growth across Southeast Asia. The programme highlights ASEAN’s commitment to environmental sustainability, renewable energy, green technology, and climate resilience, while featuring insights from industry leaders, policymakers, and experts on building a more sustainable and environmentally responsible future for the region.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (TILAWAH)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme showcases beautiful and melodic recitations by participants from Philippines, Kosovo, Iraq, and Brunei, reflecting the diversity and unity of the Muslim world through the art of Quranic recitation.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - GHAZAL TERMASYHUR
programme.desc: Ghazal Termasyhur is a special programme under Dunia Melayu organised by Johor FM, featuring a compilation of traditional Ghazal performances by renowned local artists and cultural performers from across the country. The programme celebrates the beauty and uniqueness of Malay musical heritage while preserving and promoting the timeless art of Ghazal to wider audiences.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - PUISI NUSANTARA
programme.desc: Puisi Nusantara is a magazine-style programme celebrating the richness of Malay literature and culture, featuring cultural figures and traditional music performances

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - LEGASI MARITIM MELAYU
programme.desc: Legasi Maritim Melayu is a documentary segment under Dunia Melayu that explores the rich maritime heritage of the Malay civilisation. The programme highlights the ingenuity and achievements of the Malay people in navigation, shipbuilding, seafaring knowledge, and maritime trade, showcasing their historical role as skilled sailors and influential players in regional and international maritime networks.

programme.title: Malaysia Tonight

programme.title: On The Table (OTT)
programme.desc: 'On The Table' is a talk show that explores a range of topics, emphasizing Malaysia's current issues and trends. It also seeks to position Malaysia as an appealing investment and business hub for foreign investors, featuring insights from opinion leaders and influential figures.

programme.title: World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation news program, which brings together content material in the form of features and human interest from ASEAN countries and around the world.

programme.title: Global Voices
programme.desc: 'Global Voices' is a mixed-slot program featuring a blend of engaging content, including both previously aired shows and fresh new programs that resonate with a global audience. Focusing on current issues, culture, technology, and international harmony, Global Voices aims to connect viewers with a broader perspective of the world. The program also offers inspiring stories and discussions from diverse cultural backgrounds, bringing audiences closer to the realities of our increasingly interconnected global community.

programme.title: Global - Tech Today
programme.desc: In this fast paced world of technologies and evolutions, challenges and issues are part of every day lives. Tech today brings these topics on the table for discussion with Julie Woon as the anchor.\n

programme.title: ASEAN - Kembara Alam Borneo
programme.desc: Kembara Alam Borneo is a programme under the ASEAN segment hosted by Razzuan Rosli, exploring the unique heritage and natural beauty of Borneo. The programme highlights the island’s rich cultural diversity, local traditions, and the customs of its various ethnic communities, offering viewers a closer look at the vibrant identity and way of life found across Borneo.\n

programme.title: ASEAN - Gastronomic Trail Of Asia
programme.desc: Gastronomic Trail of Asia is a programme under the ASEAN segment that takes viewers on a culinary journey across the region, exploring the flavours and recipes of diverse Asian cuisines. The programme also highlights the rich cultural heritage, ethnic traditions, and unique destinations behind each dish, offering a deeper appreciation of Asia’s vibrant food culture and communities.

programme.title: ASEAN - Bisikan Dari Kota Pusaka
programme.desc: Bisikan Dari Kota Pusaka is a programme under the ASEAN segment that explores historic administrative towns and heritage cities across the country. The programme highlights the unique history, cultural significance, architecture, and local identity of these heritage locations, offering viewers a deeper appreciation of the nation’s rich historical legacy and development.\n

programme.title: ASEAN - Simfoni Alam
programme.desc: Simfoni Alam is a documentary programme under the ASEAN segment that explores the beauty of wildlife and the natural environment while highlighting important environmental and conservation issues. The programme offers viewers greater awareness and appreciation of biodiversity, ecosystems, and the challenges faced in preserving nature and wildlife habitats.

programme.title: ASEAN - Warna-Warni Asia
programme.desc: Warna-Warni Asia is a travelogue programme under the ASEAN segment that takes viewers on a vibrant journey to explore fascinating destinations across Asia. The programme showcases the region’s colourful cultures, unique attractions, local lifestyles, and scenic landscapes, offering audiences an engaging glimpse into the diversity and beauty of Asia.

programme.title: ASEAN - Dari Borneo Ke Pantai Timur
programme.desc: Dari Borneo Ke Pantai Timur is a travel documentary under the ASEAN segment that follows the journey of a young man from Borneo as he visits and explores the East Coast for the very first time. The programme highlights his experiences discovering local culture, traditions, lifestyles, and the unique charm of the region through a fresh and personal perspective.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - Iqra'
programme.desc: Iqra’ is a programme under the Muslim World segment that focuses on Quranic learning through talaqqi and guided recitation sessions. The programme provides lessons and guidance on proper Quran reading techniques and tajwid for viewers of all age groups, promoting a deeper understanding and appreciation of Quranic recitation.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - Kota Warisan Alam
programme.desc: Kota Warisan Alam is a travelogue programme under the Dunia Melayu segment that explores heritage towns and historical cities across the country. The programme highlights interesting attractions, cultural landmarks, and unique local experiences, offering viewers insights into destinations that reflect the nation’s rich heritage and natural beauty.\n

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - Tamadun Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Tamadun Yang Hilang is a historical documentary under the Dunia Melayu segment that explores the rise, glory, and eventual fall of the Al-Andalus civilisation. The programme highlights the rich legacy of Islamic culture, knowledge, architecture, and governance in medieval Spain, while reflecting on the historical factors behind the decline of one of the world’s most influential civilisations.
